description: The Signature Computer Chip Maker and Archive — Chip Record Standard v1.0. Machine-readable canonical record for one archived chip design. All numeric values carry explicit SI units and a value kind (TARGET/SIMULATED/MEASURED). Statuses are honest: design, simulation, manufacturing, and test are separate states. No CAD, HDL, netlist, or layout artifacts exist; the only image artifact is a generated block diagram.

blocks.description: Architecture blocks (block IDs like 'S1', names, descriptions). Versioned with the record; diagram hash covers the same block list.

creation_mode.description: Provenance of the design. All seeded archive records are SIGNATURE-GENERATED.

derived_from.description: Source provenance for SOURCE-DERIVED / REMIXED records.

design_status.description: Completeness ladder. Seeded designs are CONCEPT (conceptual design — not fabrication-ready).

diagram.description: Generated block-diagram illustration (SVG, client-side). NOT a schematic. Hashed via a deterministic fingerprint of the block list it was drawn from.

diagram_fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint (xmur3 hex) of the JSON block list the diagram was drawn from. Sync-computable in browser and node.

disclaimer.description: Engineering disclaimer: generated ≠ safe / manufacturable / compliant.

engineVer.description: ChipEngine generator version that rendered this record. A design re-rendered by a newer engine is a new record version; the old spec is preserved.

id.description: Permanent archive ID. Never reused, never changed. Deep link: ?chip=<id>.

mfg_status.description: Never MANUFACTURED without manufacturing evidence on file.

name.description: Original Signature-line design name (no real manufacturer branding or part numbers).

parent_chip_id.description: Lineage parent (remixes/variants). Standalone originals carry null; parents are never mutated.

pin_groups.description: Functional pin-group map. Labeled NOT a fabrication pinout — pin-by-pin net assignments require real EDA work.

record_version.description: Version of THIS record (v1, v2, ...). Distinct from the generator engine version.

seed.description: Deterministic generation seed. Same family + seed + engine version => byte-identical record.

sim_status.description: Never SIMULATED without simulator name, version, inputs, and hash on file.

specs.description: Unit-labeled specifications. Every entry carries an explicit SI unit and kind.

unit.description: SI unit (GHz, W, mm², V, mm, nm-class, bits, ns, count). Never blank.

test_status.description: Never TESTED without test evidence on file.

units_precision.description: How numeric values are rounded (e.g. '2 decimal places, mm-based; power to 2 decimals').

value_kind.description: Class of every numeric value in this record. Seeded records are GENERATED_TARGET (design targets, never measured).

title: JAH Chip Record
